description: Implement the per-repo polling loop. For each configured repo, on each interval tick: call GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments?since=<lastPolled> and GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/comments?since=<lastPolled>, paginate both until exhausted. Subtract one second from lastPolled to overlap the window slightly, then deduplicate by comment ID. Update lastPolled after each successful poll. Run repos in parallel within a single tick.
title: Per-repo polling loop with since-timestamp persistence
